description: edge-proxy-next: 拦截未知路径或方法 (bdot.in)
expression: (http.host eq "edge-next.bdot.in" and not ((((http.request.method eq "GET") or (http.request.method eq "POST")) and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/edge/")) or (http.request.method eq "GET" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/sub/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/preferred/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/clash/"))) or (http.request.method eq "POST" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin/preferred-ips/"))))
